description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class for handling REST API requests in the installer module of the OrangeHRM project. It provides a common execute method that processes HTTP requests, manages content types and request methods, and handles exceptions by setting appropriate HTTP response codes and messages. The class declares placeholder methods for handling GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, which are meant to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract base class for installer REST API controllers, providing common request processing and exception handling functionality.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that handles incoming HTTP requests, processes content, dispatches to specific handlers based on request method, and manages errors with appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.description: Placeholder method for handling GET requests; to be implemented by subclasses.
